card.line: Mount Gilboa is a mountain range east of the plain of Jezreel, where Saul and his sons died in battle against the Philistines.

moments.title: Saul camps at Gilboa
moments.text: The Philistines camped at Shunem, and Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa. When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.

moments.title: Saul and his sons die
moments.text: The men of Israel fled, and many fell on Mount Gilboa. The Philistines killed Saul's sons, and Saul fell on his own sword. He died with his three sons that day.

moments.title: The Philistines find Saul
moments.text: The next day the Philistines came to strip the dead and found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa. They cut off Saul's head and took his armor. Then the men of Jabesh-gilead took back the bodies.

moments.title: The Amalekite's report
moments.text: A young man told David he had been on Mount Gilboa. He said he saw Saul leaning on his spear and killed him at Saul's request. He brought Saul's crown to David.

moments.title: David's song of sorrow
moments.text: David grieved for Saul and Jonathan. He called out to the mountains of Gilboa, where the shield of Saul was defiled, and said, "How the mighty have fallen!"
